title: Isoniazid-resistant, rifampin-susceptible TB
dek: Hr-TB is not MDR. WHO: 6 months of rifampin, ethambutol, pyrazinamide, and levofloxacin. Do not add INH as theatre, and do not escalate to BPaLM without RR.
story: Hr-TB means isoniazid resistance with preserved rifampin. It is commoner than programmes admit because INH DST is not on the Xpert cartridge. katG S315T versus inhA promoter changes whether high-dose INH or ETH could ever have counted; for the WHO 6-month Hr regimen they mostly do not have to.

WHO recommends 6 months of RIF, EMB, PZA, plus levofloxacin (6REZ-Lfx) for Hr-TB. INH is omitted. Duration is not 2HRZE/4HR with a shrug. If FQ cannot be used, longer REZ-type constructs exist in the handbook — inferior, not imaginary.

If the “Hr” call was really a missed RR (Xpert false S, I491F), you have been treating MDR with a FQ-augmented DS backbone. Discordant RIF NAAT/phenotype is a reason to sequence rpoB fully before celebrating a simple Hr regimen.
deepTitle: Finding Hr-TB in a RIF-first world
deep: LPAs (MTBDRplus), tNGS, and WGS find katG/inhA while Xpert only watched rpoB. Programmes that skip INH genotyping will misfile Hr as DS.
High-dose INH does not rescue S315T. inhA-only strains are the historical high-dose INH story; WHO’s 6REZ-Lfx simply sidesteps INH.
Do not use moxifloxacin-containing HPMZ for known Hr without thinking: you may still want a FQ, but the H in HPMZ is dead.
Contacts of Hr-TB: TPT is not 6Lfx (that is for RR/MDR contacts). INH-based TPT is misbuilt; rifamycin TPT (4R/3HR) is the logical DS-minus-INH idea — NTP-specific.

visual.caption: Hr-TB is an INH problem with a live rifamycin. Genotype tells you whether leftover INH/ETH fantasies are even coherent; the WHO regimen just adds a FQ and drops H.

example.title: Xpert RIF-S, LPA INH-R katG S315T
example.setup: New pulmonary TB, Ultra RIF not detected, MTBDRplus katG S315T, inhA WT. Team continues 2HRZE.

steps.title: This is Hr-TB
steps.body: Stop counting INH. Six months of REZ plus levofloxacin is the WHO recipe.

steps.title: Confirm RIF once if the story is odd
steps.body: If the patient fails, think missed non-RRDR rpoB, not “add more INH.”

steps.title: Do not start BPaLM
steps.body: Rifampin is still the sterilizing backbone. Escalating to Pa/BDQ without RR is the wrong ladder.

example.takeaway: Hr-TB: keep RIF, drop INH, add Lfx for 6 months.
